cases.title: Practicing, next names Pop: turn 1 proposes the snapshot's own proposal (Door), not Pop; Pop only in the one memory clause; ends on the choice

rubric.reason: Turn 1 opens with one memory clause about Pop with how long ago ('Yesterday, Pop's pivot went in while Pop was still shrunk...'), which draws on the record's summary more than its `next` but stays on the same Pop full-size point. It then asks the intent question and proposes the snapshot's Door ('Door could swing from the middle of its left edge. Want to try that one?'), not Pop, ending on the choice.
The opening turn is a memory clause, the intent question and a one-sentence fallback proposal, ending on 'Want to try that one?', with no lesson statement, leave-out or layer list.

Pop and its shrunk/full-size pose come from the learner record, and 'Yesterday' matches last_practiced 2026-10-25. Door and 'the middle of its left edge' match the snapshot's proposal (Door, middle-left).
